summary.text: Jonathan "Jack" Fazzino is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for Connecticut State Senate District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Democrat and attorney, he has represented District 83 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since January 2023 and is not seeking re-election to that seat.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan "Jack" Fazzino graduated from New Britain High School in 2012, earned a bachelor's degree in political science and government from the University of Notre Dame in 2016, a master's degree in American government and U.S. politics from Georgetown University, and a law degree from Boston College Law School in 2020.
His career experience includes working as an attorney at Cohen and Wolf, P.C., and he was elected to the Berlin Town Council in November 2021.
Fazzino was first elected to the House in 2022, defeating Republican Lou Arata 50.6 percent to 49.4 percent, and won re-election in 2024 over Republican Joseph Vollano, 54.7 percent to 45.3 percent.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Executive and Legislative Nominations, Judiciary (as vice chair) and Transportation committees.
He advanced from the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary for the Senate seat.
